_comment: Copy one of the two server blocks below into your MCP client's config (for Claude Code, a .mcp.json in the project root, or your user-level config). Replace the absolute paths. Keep only one 'antigravity-delegate' key.

antigravity-delegate._comment_cli_only: No secrets needed: delegate_to_antigravity_cli uses whatever Google account `agy` is logged into. delegate_to_antigravity (the SDK tool) will report missing credentials if called without a key, which is harmless.

_antigravity-delegate-with-sdk-key._comment_with_key: Use this variant instead if you also want the SDK-backed tool. Do NOT commit a real key.
